name: Product feedback
about: One concrete HighLevel product / UX / workflow issue or improvement

labels: "Status: New, Impact: Not assessed"
assignees: ""

## Product
<!-- e.g. Meeting Room, Communities, Ask AI, Platform -->

## Type
<!-- Feature, UX, Bug, Platform, Localization, Performance, or another clear type -->

## Date reported
<!-- YYYY-MM-DD -->

## Source
<!-- Link or exact local source file/date. Add every source when this is a merged duplicate. -->

## Observed
<!-- What happens now? Keep it concrete. -->

## Why it matters
<!-- Real user/business consequence. One or two sentences. -->

## Expected
<!-- What should the user be able to do instead? -->

## Evidence
<!-- Screenshot, video, URL, reproduction steps — only when useful. -->

## HighLevel response
<!-- Add only after they reply. -->

## Impact
<!-- High, Medium, Low, or Not assessed. Explain only when it helps prioritization. -->

## Last verified
<!-- YYYY-MM-DD and what was checked; leave blank until evidence is checked. -->

## Status
New — no verified acceptance or delivery yet.
